briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Bleed the Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow: Warden Duel. Enter Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow on Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate while the Gate remains Sealed Gate with fae time bleed. Reference deity voice is Brigid, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the elite lock against Sídhe Thorn Knight inside the elite-tuned Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow and prove the active deity can endure the trial alone.

missionIntro.speaker: Brigid Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A geas is a road that remembers the foot that broke it. The Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the elite pressure of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: geas thorns that punish forbidden actions

victory.speaker: Brigid Divine Voice
victory.text: The root remembers obedience and opens one more ring.

defeat.speaker: Brigid Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The Silver-Root Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Avalora is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow as part of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow as a elite node in Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth; silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.
